caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wall clock with a wooden frame colored in various brown shades, displaying a three-dimensional appearance through shading. The upper portion of the clock face is square with a white background and features Roman numerals in black, a circular gold center, and black hour and minute hands. The lower portion of the clock has a decorative panel with an ornate oval design in the center, containing an image of a yellow urn holding blue and white flowers, surrounded by a black background and white floral elements, all set within a pale blue, yellow, and white border. The drawing appears centered on a cream-colored background, with a faint pencil outline forming a rectangle around the clock. A signature reading “Phillips” is present near the lower right of the pencil border.
title: Clock
